name: pieceofcake2/async-aws
description: AsyncAws integration for CakePHP 2: DynamoDB session handler and cache, Amazon SES email transport, S3 helper

suggest.async-aws/dynamo-db: Required for the DynamoDB session handler and cache engine
suggest.async-aws/s3: Required for the S3 client of the AsyncAws component
suggest.async-aws/ses: Required for the Amazon SES email transport
suggest.async-aws/simple-s3: Required for S3Storage and the SimpleS3 client (installs async-aws/s3)
